name: libretto
description: Edit a Libretto site from Claude Code: the Libretto MCP server plus skills for editing pages, the design system, visual checks, publishing and reporting issues

libretto_token.title: Libretto site token
libretto_token.description: The token made in the Libretto admin (user menu > Agenti e accessi MCP). Stored in the system keychain, never in settings.json. The LIBRETTO_MCP_TOKEN environment variable overrides it.

libretto_url.title: Libretto address
libretto_url.description: Where your Libretto runs, without a trailing slash. Change it only for a test install. The LIBRETTO_URL environment variable overrides it.
